2607.27635.title: HealthCAT: An Interpretable Encoder-only Transformer Framework for Health Indicator Prediction and Temporal Interpretation of Wearable Sensor Data
2607.27635.paper_summary: Wearable sensors continuously capture fine-grained multivariate time-series data, providing opportunities to model behavioural patterns associated with health outcomes. However, existing deep learning methods prioritise predictive accuracy over interpretability, limiting their application in health research. In this study, we present HealthCAT, a flexible framework that integrates an Encoder-only Transformer with an Attentive Class Activation Token (AttentiveCAT) to generate class-specific, time-step-level interpretations. These interpretations can be mapped back onto behavioural cycles that are relevant to the domain (e.g., time-of-day), supporting individual-level analysis of wearable sensor data. We evaluated HealthCAT using two real-world wearable sensor datasets (306 participants in total). HealthCAT outperformed deep learning baselines by up to 17\% in F1-score and 12\% in accuracy on both datasets ($p<0.05$). In masking experiments, the time steps identified by HealthCAT carried significantly more predictive value than random selection across all masking conditions ($p<0.05$), indicating that the identified time steps are predictively informative. By coupling predictive performance with validated time-step-level interpretability, HealthCAT moves wearable sensor analysis beyond aggregated metrics towards temporal patterns that support health monitoring, behavioural pattern analysis, and intervention design in health research. The significance of this work is that it enables accurate prediction of health indicators from wearable sensor data while providing insights into when and how physical activity patterns occur, rather than relying solely on aggregated summary measures.
2607.27635.paper_summary_zh: 可穿戴傳感器持續捕捉細粒度的多變量時間序列數據，提供了建模與健康結果相關的行為模式的機會。然後，現有的深度學習方法優先考慮預測準確性而非可解釋性，限制了其在健康研究中的應用。在本研究中，我們提出了HealthCAT，一個靈活的框架，將僅編碼器的Transformer與關注類別激活標記（AttentiveCAT）整合，以生成類別特定的時間步級別解釋。這些解釋可以映射回與領域相關的行為週期（例如，時間段），支持對可穿戴傳感器數據的個體級分析。我們使用兩個真實世界的可穿戴傳感器數據集（共306名參與者）評估了HealthCAT。在兩個數據集中，HealthCAT在F1分數上比深度學習基準提高了最多17\%，在準確性上提高了12\%（$p<0.05$）。在遮蔽實驗中，HealthCAT識別的時間步在所有遮蔽條件下的預測價值顯著高於隨機選擇（$p<0.05$），表明所識別的時間步在預測上具有信息價值。通過將預測性能與經驗證的時間步級別可解釋性相結合，HealthCAT使可穿戴傳感器分析超越了聚合指標，朝向支持健康監測、行為模式分析和健康研究中的干預設計的時間模式。這項工作的意義在於，它能夠從可穿戴傳感器數據中準確預測健康指標，同時提供有關身體活動模式何時以及如何發生的見解，而不僅僅依賴於聚合的摘要度量。
